title.rendered: WORD4TODAY; Indeed, good times are coming back

content.rendered:
?

Psalms 85:1b MSG
…You brought good times back to Jacob!
?
Jacob again had reasons to testify after a long draught.. God turned things around for him.

?Note, when God turns things around in someone’s favour, it is never like the way things were initially. It’s never about God maintaining the “status quo..” God takes things a little further. He does much more.
?
A classic example was the case of king Nebuchadnezzar.

?We all know his story of pride & and how God turned him into a frightening creature, yet, when God brought good times back to him, his level, influence, affluence all changed in a jiffy.

Hear him?

Daniel 4:36 MSG
“At the same time that I was given back my mind, I was also given back my majesty and splendor, making my kingdom shine. All the leaders and important people came looking for me. I was reestablished as king in my kingdom and became greater than ever.✔

Whaooo.? What a great return.

You will recall king Nebuchadnezzar too once enjoyed very good times.
He had it all going for him until Satan entered into him and at this dark hour in his life, everyone forsook him.
?If God did it for Jacob. Did it for Nebuchadnezzar, did it for Joseph, yours is just a ” piece of cake.”?
When God did it for Nebuchadnezzar, all those who forsook him returned to associate with him.

✔God will reestablish you.
He will bring good times back into your life, home, business, academics, office, career etc. Not the kind of good times you enjoyed before 2020, but good times on a greater level and dimension.

✔This time, important people, influential people will come looking for you, not only to associate with you, but more importantly to make you greater than you were before in Jesus name??
